headline: As of 2026-10-23: 21,258,393 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 46 of 50 states, D+13.0 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 21,258,393 early/mail ballots cast so far across 46 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+13.0 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (2,746,297), California (2,350,922), Florida (1,982,613).
